researches.title: Origins of the Square-Root Law for Covert Quantum Communication and Its Photon Bound
researches.question: What is the primary source of the square-root law for covert quantum communication, and how does it bound the signal that can be sent without detection by a photon-counting warden?

researches.title: Mechanisms Limiting Long-Run Entanglement Attempt Rates: Cooling, Detector Recovery, Signalling and Covert Scheduling
researches.question: Which physical or operational mechanisms limit the long-run average number of entanglement-generation attempts in a quantum network link over many time slots (for example source duty cycle, ion heating and recooling, detector recovery, or covertness against a warden), as opposed to limits within a single attempt?
